criterion5Inventory.conclusion: No Git 2.31.0 binary on this host; not an exhaustive disk search. The denied build (D013) was not retried.

followups.summary: The JavaScript reading names a GIT_* identifier only as a member or before ':' in an object literal; a shorthand property passes a scoped GIT_* name to a child Git unnamed. The tree has no such shorthand today.

processCorrections: The first surface-probe run included an apostrophe inside "${unset:-...}", which this host's sh rejects as a syntax error, and its summary counted JavaScript readings as shell errors; the text was replaced by a braced parameter before an apostrophe and the summary filter corrected before the recorded run.
The template-literal carrier's expected line was one too low in the first draft; it was corrected before any run.
One Git inventory command used unmatched zsh globs and zsh did not run it; the cellar was listed again without a glob.
The bounded wrapper refuses to start outside the worktree root; the subdirectory runs were repeated from the root with sh -c changing directory.
The first parse of the pairing reproducer's output read the bounded-start line as JSON; it was reparsed from the result object.

The four probe files failed Prettier when first copied into the evidence directory; they were formatted with prettier --write on those four paths only and rerun from their committed paths, which produced the results above.

The draft report and this record first said no git executable sits under /opt; the search covered regular files four levels deep and so could not see Homebrew's symlinked entry or its cellar binary. Both were corrected to the search's actual bounds before filing.
